full_prompt_en: A square, near-monochrome fashion portrait shows two young women standing shoulder to shoulder against a muted gray studio background. Their pale faces occupy the upper half of the frame, while broad glossy black visor bands run horizontally across both sets of eyes and form the strongest graphic shape in the image. The woman on the left stands slightly forward and turns a little toward the right, with dark hair parted centrally and smoothed into a low, orderly arrangement. Her lips are softly parted, and the nose and lower cheeks remain gently lit beneath the opaque band. Beside her, the woman on the right faces almost straight toward the camera, her equally sleek dark hair framing a calm, closed expression. Both wear high-necked black clothing with layered fabric near the collar, so their shoulders and torsos merge gradually into the lower dark region. The left collar has a narrow pale trim that traces one edge before disappearing into shadow. The two visor shapes align closely but do not quite become a single strip; the gap between their faces gives the repeated motif its rhythm. Gray light falls softly from the front and above, keeping the skin matte and smooth while the bands retain a harder, faintly reflective finish. The plain background has subtle tonal mottling rather than a crisp horizon or visible room. The image keeps its details restrained, allowing the contrast between pale skin, dark fabric, and the severe horizontal bars to carry the composition. The overall arrangement is symmetrical but slightly offset, austere and futuristic in its measured monochrome balance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、近乎单色的时尚肖像中，两位年轻女子并肩站在灰调影棚背景前。她们浅亮的面孔占据画面上半部，宽而微亮的黑色遮罩横贯两人的眼部，成为图像最强的图形形状。左侧女子略微靠前，身体稍朝右转，深发中分，平整地梳成低而规整的发型。她的嘴唇微张，不透明遮罩下的鼻子和下半张脸受到柔和照明。旁边的右侧女子几乎正对镜头，头发同样光顺，平静地闭合双唇。两人都穿着高领黑色服装，领口附近有层叠面料，肩膀和躯干逐渐融入下方深色区域。左边领口有一道窄浅边，在阴影里消失前勾出部分轮廓。两条遮罩彼此齐平，却没有完全连成一体；两张脸之间的缝隙让重复图形形成节奏。灰色光线从前方与上方柔和落下，使皮肤保持哑光平滑，而遮罩带有更硬、更微微反光的表面。朴素背景只有细微的明暗斑驳，没有清楚地平线或室内陈设。图像克制细节，让浅色皮肤、暗色衣料和严厉的横条之间的对照承担构图。整体安排对称却略有错位，经过精确控制的黑白平衡显得冷峻而未来感十足。
style_prompt_en: The image has a restrained fashion-photography finish in muted gray, charcoal, and pale ivory tones. Smooth matte gradients shape the brighter forms, while large opaque dark blocks cut across them with unusually firm horizontal edges. Repeated bands establish a measured rhythm; slight offsets keep the arrangement from becoming mechanically mirrored. Fine tonal mottling softens the otherwise plain ground, and layered dark surfaces fade into one another near the lower edge. Frontal light is diffuse and cool, preserving subtle volume without dramatic cast shadows, while limited glossy reflection on the hardest shapes sharpens the contrast of materials. The overall effect is minimal, severe, and carefully balanced.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现克制的时尚摄影质感，以低饱和灰色、炭黑和浅象牙色构成。平滑哑光渐层塑造较亮的形体，大块不透明暗色则以格外坚实的横向边缘切过其上。重复的带状形建立有节制的节奏，轻微错位使布局免于机械镜像。细微影调斑驳柔化原本平坦的底色，下缘的层叠暗面彼此渐渐融合。正面漫射冷光保留细腻体积而没有戏剧性投影，最硬的形状上有限的光泽反射则加强了材质对照。整体效果极简、冷峻且精心平衡。
theme_en: Two women in dark dress with broad black visors across their eyes
theme_zh: 两位身穿深色衣服、眼前横覆宽黑色遮罩的女子
